name: [UPDATE] REALISTIC HOME DEFENSE
desc:
WELCOME TO REALISTIC HOME DEFENSE

Experience realistic weapon mechanics, tactical movement, and intense home-defense action! Master your aim, use your equipment, and defend your home under pressure.

🎉 Check out our Socials! Join giveaways, share feedback, and report cheaters!

💸 MONEY MULTIPLIERS
- 👥 Play with friends to earn bonus cash!
- 🏆 Join our Roblox group for an extra money multiplier!

🎮 CONTROLS (PC / Console)
- Fire — Left Click / RT
- Aim — Right Click / LT
- Reload — R / X
- Fire Mode — V / RB
- Sprint — Shift / L3
- Crouch / Prone — C / B
- Lean — Q, E / D-Pad
- Switch Weapon — 1-9 / Y, LB
- Interact — G / X

📱 Mobile: on-screen buttons, editable in Settings

🎯 STAY SHARP. STAY TACTICAL. STAY READY.

Every second counts. Every decision matters.

Do you have what it takes to survive?

👍 LIKE the game and FOLLOW for future updates, new content, and improvements!
